    fix(db): S1-DB-01 R2 — down.sql gate, bounded timeouts reset, hardened partition guard, behavioural proof harness
    
    Remediates R1 audit findings (execution/audits/s1-r1/{a,b}) on 620b47fc:
    
    - rollback.sql -> down.sql so the repo reversibility gate (migration-dry-run
      reversibility-check) applies; down.sql now restores the original function
      bodies and comments exactly (forward->down->forward pg_dump parity proven).
    - RESET lock_timeout/statement_timeout at the end of migration.sql and
      down.sql so the bounds cannot leak into later migrations on the same
      connection (A-03); comments describe observed, not assumed, atomicity (B-04).
    - community_messages_protect_partition(regclass) refuses anything that is not
      a partition of public.community_messages in schema public (A-07/B-05).
    - verify.sql: fixed array-literal bug that masked the real failure message;
      added allowed-path assertions (service_role keeps all privileges, partitions
      attached) (B-06).
    - Recovery guidance corrected: `prisma migrate resolve --rolled-back` is not a
      recovery after an out-of-band reversal (P3012 on clean history; silent no-op
      when an earlier failed row exists — both observed); re-apply with
      psql --single-transaction and run verify.sql. Never edit _prisma_migrations.
    - test/db/s1-rls-close-public-exposure.sh: bash+psql harness for a disposable
      local PG 17 cluster — pre-state twin (parent chain + rls_fitness_backend.sql
      reproduces the 18 exposed relations), lock_timeout failure/atomicity/recovery
      on a separate DB, deny matrix for anon/authenticated on all 18, allow for
      service_role/postgres, RLS layer proven independently of grants, parent-path
      community behaviour unchanged, future partition protected at creation,
      populated data preserved, reversibility parity, false-"up to date" invariant.
      68/68 checks pass on PG 17.6 (evidence in execution/s1-database/proof-run-04.log,
      re-run head-bound after this commit).
    
    Still NOT: audited-clear, merged, deployed, or live-verified. Serving DB role
    remains an external unknown (see RUNTIME_ROLE_VERIFICATION_PACKET.md rev 2).
